MUS.note: The document covers a regulator's committee on mobile mast deployment, not a national broadband plan with targets.
A regulator's committee on mobile masts; no government-run or built system is stated.

facts.fact: ICTA's multi-stakeholder committee, with Mauritius Telecom, Emtel and MTML present, held its first meeting on Friday before 24 November 2026 and took up revision of the PPG7 planning guidance for telecom infrastructure as a priority.
facts.system: ICTA multi-stakeholder committee on mobile masts
